-- CP11 schema change demo, step 2: the GUARDED pipeline.
-- G1: L1 is the contract layer. Explicit columns, explicit casts, business names, never select *.
-- L2: two Dynamic Table tiers so a failure (or a deliberate suspend) can be seen downstream.
-- Rerunning rebuilds the guarded pipeline from the current L0 (used by 79_restore.sql).

create schema if not exists {{DEMO_DB}}.L1 comment = 'Guarded L1: contract views over the CLD stand-in';
create schema if not exists {{DEMO_DB}}.L2 comment = 'Guarded L2: Dynamic Tables';

create or replace view {{DEMO_DB}}.L1.L1_EQUIPMENT
  comment = 'G1 contract view: explicit columns and casts over L0 EQUIPMENT'
as select EQUIPMENT::varchar        as EQUIPMENT_ID,
          EQUIPMENTNAME::varchar    as EQUIPMENT_NAME,
          case PLANT::varchar when '1710' then 'Mine A' when '1010' then 'Mine B' else 'Other' end as SITE,
          FLEETTYPE::varchar        as FLEET_TYPE,
          'SAP'                     as PROVENANCE
   from {{DEMO_L0}}.MAINTENANCE.EQUIPMENT;

create or replace view {{DEMO_DB}}.L1.L1_MAINT_NOTIFICATION
  comment = 'G1 contract view: explicit columns and casts over L0 MAINT_NOTIFICATION'
as select MAINTENANCENOTIFICATION::varchar as NOTIFICATION_ID,
          EQUIPMENT::varchar               as EQUIPMENT_ID,
          NOTIFICATIONTYPE::varchar        as NOTIFICATION_TYPE,
          PRIORITY::varchar                as PRIORITY,
          CREATEDON::date                  as CREATED_ON,
          DOWNTIMEHOURS::number(10,2)      as DOWNTIME_HOURS,
          'SAP'                            as PROVENANCE
   from {{DEMO_L0}}.MAINTENANCE.MAINT_NOTIFICATION;

create or replace dynamic table {{DEMO_DB}}.L2.DT_EQUIPMENT_DOWNTIME
  target_lag = '2 minutes' warehouse = {{WAREHOUSE}} refresh_mode = incremental
  comment = 'Guarded L2: downtime by machine and month. Protected by ALERT_SCHEMA_GUARD.'
as select e.SITE, e.FLEET_TYPE, e.EQUIPMENT_ID, e.EQUIPMENT_NAME,
          date_trunc('month', n.CREATED_ON) as MONTH,
          count(*) as NOTIFICATIONS, sum(n.DOWNTIME_HOURS) as DOWNTIME_HOURS
   from {{DEMO_DB}}.L1.L1_MAINT_NOTIFICATION n
   join {{DEMO_DB}}.L1.L1_EQUIPMENT e on e.EQUIPMENT_ID = n.EQUIPMENT_ID
   group by all;

create or replace dynamic table {{DEMO_DB}}.L2.DT_SITE_SUMMARY
  target_lag = '2 minutes' warehouse = {{WAREHOUSE}} refresh_mode = incremental
  comment = 'Guarded L2 tier 2: downtime by site and month'
as select SITE, MONTH, sum(NOTIFICATIONS) as NOTIFICATIONS, sum(DOWNTIME_HOURS) as DOWNTIME_HOURS
   from {{DEMO_DB}}.L2.DT_EQUIPMENT_DOWNTIME
   group by all;

select count(*) || ' rows in guarded DT_EQUIPMENT_DOWNTIME' from {{DEMO_DB}}.L2.DT_EQUIPMENT_DOWNTIME;
